Stage 1 · Warm-up

Warm-up

By the end you can greet people (formal and informal), say goodbye, introduce yourself and ask someone's name.

How to study this lesson
  • How to study this lesson
  • • About 20–30 minutes. Work from top to bottom.
  • • Headphones on. Say your answers out loud.
  • • After each check, read the “why”. That is your teacher.

By the end you can greet people (formal and informal), say goodbye, introduce yourself and ask someone's name.

👥

Today you work with a partner. Speak out loud — mistakes are OK.

Quick recall from Lesson 1. Choose, then check.
1👍 coffee → ___ coffee.
2👎 Mondays → ___ Mondays.
3🐢 Ask for slower speech: “___, please.”
4👍 music → ___ music.
5👎 rain → ___ rain.
6👂 Listen means “use your ears”.
7🔁 Repeat means “say it again”.

9🙏 Sorry is a polite word.

Why these answers

From Lesson 1: I like / I don’t like + noun; “Slowly, please.”

Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

I'm… / You're… / Are you…?
PersonPositive (+)Question (?)
II'm Anna.—
youYou're Tom.Are you Tom?
  • I'm = I am. You're = you are. Use them to say who you are.
  • Ask a name: What's your name? — Answer: I'm…
  • A yes/no question: Are you…? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

→ he is / she is / they are come in Lesson 4.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: I am → I'm Anna. Question: flip it — Are you Tom? — Yes, I am.
  • ⚠ Russian and Kazakh often skip 'am/is' (Я — Анна · Мен Анна). English never skips it: I AM Anna.

Stage 4 · Practice

Practice A

Choose the best reply.
1“Hello, I'm Anna.” →
2“What's your name?” →
3“Goodbye!” →
4“Are you Tom?” →
5“Good morning!” →
6“Nice to meet you.” →
7“Hi!” →
8“See you later!” →

Why these answers

Reply to a name with your name; end a chat with “See you later.”

Office or friend? Choose the right hello.

👔 = office (formal). 😎 = friend (informal).

1“Good morning.”
2“Hi! How are you?”
3“Hello. Nice to meet you.”
4“Hey! See you later!”
5“Good afternoon, Mr Brown.”
6“Hiya! What's up?”
Why these answers

Formal (office): Hello, Good morning, Nice to meet you. Informal (friends): Hi, Hey, See you later.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines: say hello + your name, then say goodbye.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

Hello! I'm Sara. Nice to meet you. Goodbye!

Check yourself:

  • Did you use Hello / Hi …?
  • Did you use I'm …?
  • Did you say goodbye?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi! 👋

Sam

I'm Sam. What's your name?

Sam

Nice to meet you! 🤝

Sam

Are you a teacher?

Sam

Cool! 😎

Sam

Now listen. I say: “I are Sam.” 🤔

Why

With I we say “I’m” (I am), never “I are”.

Sam

Yes! “I’m Sam.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you said hello, introduced yourself, and caught my mistake. Next time, say your lines out loud too.
